Sub CreateJejuCarrotSlides()
Dim pptApp As Object
Dim pptPresentation As Object
Dim slide As Object
Dim shape As Object
Dim imgPath As String
Dim i As Integer
Dim imgFile As String
' Step 0: Open the current PowerPoint file
Set pptApp = CreateObject("PowerPoint.Application")
pptApp.Visible = True
' If there is no open presentation, create a new one
If pptApp.Presentations.Count = 0 Then
Set pptPresentation = pptApp.Presentations.Add
Else
Set pptPresentation = pptApp.ActivePresentation
End If
' Step 1: Define image file path (assuming the images are in the same folder as the PPT file)
imgPath = pptPresentation.Path & "\"
' Step 2 & 3: Add 5 slides sequentially with images and text overlay
For i = 1 To 5
imgFile = imgPath & "image" & i & ".webp"
Set slide = pptPresentation.Slides.Add(i, 1) ' Add slide in title layout
' Insert Image
Set shape = slide.Shapes.AddPicture(imgFile, msoFalse, msoCTrue, 0, 0, pptPresentation.PageSetup.SlideWidth, pptPresentation.PageSetup.SlideHeight)
' Add Text Box
Set shape = slide.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 50, 400, 600, 100)
shape.TextFrame.TextRange.Text = GetSlideText(i)
shape.TextFrame.TextRange.Font.Size = 24
shape.TextFrame.TextRange.Font.Color = RGB(0, 0, 0) ' Black text color
shape.Fill.BackColor.RGB = RGB(255, 255, 255) ' White background
shape.TextFrame.TextRange.ParagraphFormat.Alignment = 2 ' Center align
Next i
' Release objects
Set slide = Nothing
Set pptPresentation = Nothing
Set pptApp = Nothing
End Sub

' Function to return text for each slide
Function GetSlideText(slideNumber As Integer) As String
Select Case slideNumber
Case 1: GetSlideText = "Jeju carrots – the deeper you dive, the more fascinating they become!"
Case 2: GetSlideText = "Born from Jeju’s volcanic soil and ocean breeze, these carrots hold the essence of nature."
Case 3: GetSlideText = "Packed with intense sweetness and crunch, Jeju carrots aren’t just tasty—they’re a powerhouse of nutrition!"
Case 4: GetSlideText = "From skincare to desserts, Jeju carrots are revolutionizing the way we use this humble vegetable!"
Case 5: GetSlideText = "Once you taste Jeju carrots, there's no going back! Discover the real flavor of nature’s gift."
End Select
End Function
